zone out: I was so tired during the long lecture that I started to zone out and missed the homework instructions.
冗長的講課中我太累了，開始恍神，錯過了作業說明。
be zoned for housing: The empty land near the river is zoned for housing, so no factories can be built there.
河邊那塊空地被劃為住宅區，所以那裡不能蓋工廠。
in the zone: The basketball player was in the zone tonight and scored forty points without missing a shot.
那位籃球員今晚狀態極佳，得了四十分，一球都沒失手。
a comfort zone: Joining the speech contest pushed me out of my comfort zone, but I learned a lot from it.
參加演講比賽把我推出了舒適圈，但我從中學到很多。
time zone: London is in a different time zone, so it's still morning there when we eat dinner in Taipei.
倫敦在不同的時區，所以我們在台北吃晚餐時，那裡還是早上。
zoom in on the problem: Instead of talking about everything, let's zoom in on the problem of students using phones in class.
與其什麼都談，不如讓我們聚焦在學生上課用手機的問題上。
zoom in: If you zoom in on the photo, you can clearly see the name written on the boy's shirt.
如果你把照片放大，就能清楚看到男孩衣服上寫的名字。
prices zoomed: After the typhoon destroyed many farms, vegetable prices zoomed to twice the normal level.
颱風摧毀許多農田後，蔬菜價格飆漲到平常的兩倍。
zoom past: A sports car zoomed past us on the highway at a speed much faster than the limit.
一輛跑車在高速公路上以遠超過速限的速度從我們旁邊呼嘯而過。
zoom out: When you feel stuck on small details, zoom out and look at the big picture of your plan.
當你卡在小細節時，就把視野拉遠，綜觀你計畫的全局。
